rows.col_1: GET https://developer.api.autodesk.com/construction/transmittals/v1/projects/{projectId}/transmittals/{transmittalId}/documents
user context optional
data:read
JSON
Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is obtained via either a two-legged or three-legged OAuth flow.

The Autodesk ID of the user on whose behalf the request is made.
This header is required only when using two-legged authentication. It is not needed for three-legged authentication.
Your application can access only those users who are assigned to it in the SaaS Integrations UI.
Only user Autodesk IDs (autodeskId) are supported.

The ID of the project.
You can retrieve the project ID using the Data Management API. For more details, see the Retrieve a Project ID tutorial.
You may provide the project ID with or without the b. prefix:

With prefix: b.657a5565-09b7-48e0-bd03-acacfe42efaf
Without prefix: 657a5565-09b7-48e0-bd03-acacfe42efaf
The ID of the transmittal. To find the ID, call GET transmittals.

The maximum number of results to return per page.
Acceptable values: 1-200.
Default value: 20.
For example, to limit the response to two results per page, use limit=2.

The index from which the response starts returning results.
Default value: 0.
For example, to skip the first three results, use offset=3.

Sorts the document results by a supported field and order.
By default, results are sorted in ascending order by name (name asc).
To sort in descending order, add desc after the field name.
Format: sort=<field> [asc or desc]
Possible values: name, title, version, lastUpdatedAt, updatedByName.
Examples:

sort=name asc – sorts documents alphabetically by name.
sort=lastUpdatedAt desc – sorts documents by last update time (newest first).
Successfully retrieved the documents included in the transmittal
The transmittal has been created and is currently being processed but not ready for review yet. The documents list will be empty.
Operation failed because of bad user input
Unauthorized error
The user does not have permission to perform this operation.
The project or transmittal does not exist
Internal server error
The list of documents that were included in the transmittal when it was issued.
The URN of the document.
The name of the document.
The description of the document, if provided.
The title of the document.
The version number of the document at the time the transmittal was issued.
The file name of the document.

The approval status of the file version.
For more information, see File Review Statuses documentation.

The customized label of the approval status.
Max length: 255

The value of the approval status.
Possible values: APPROVED, REJECTED
The date and time when the file was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.
The name of the user who last modified the document.
The Autodesk ID of the user who created the file. For details about the user, call GET user.

Indicates whether the file is deleted.
true – The file is deleted, either directly or because its parent folder was deleted.
false – The file is not deleted.
The URN of the folder that contains the document.
The type of folder that contains the document.
The revision label assigned to the document.
The storage URN of the document. You can use the storage URN to download the document. For details, see the Download Files tutorial.
The list of pagination details for the response.
The maximum number of results returned per page.
The number of results skipped before the current page, starting from zero.
The total number of results that match the query, regardless of pagination.
The URL to retrieve the next page of transmittal documents. If this field is not included, the current page is the last page.
This list of results will be empty.
